actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed >30 units in the last round, and my wallet (65.98) exceeds the free‑rider threshold, so I contribute the minimal 1 unit and broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.

So rule: if any other resident contributed >30 in most recent round, punish. None. Else if wallet > free_rider_threshold (10), contribute minimum amount that still counts as contribution (1 unit) to stay below threshold and keep pool small. Wallet is 65.98 >10, can contribute 1 unit. So we should contribute 1. Also broadcast short discouragement. We can do both: one physical (contribute) and one communication (broadcast). That matches rule. So actions: contribute 1, broadcast "Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low". Explanation accordingly.
